name: Haramasete Seiryuu-kun! ~Jinginaki Onna no Tatakai~
original_name: 孕ませて青龍君!～仁義なき女の闘い～
source:
It seems that everyone is fighting over the main character Seiryu-kun's genes!! They've even made a competition out of it! However, little do they know of the suspicious plot behind the whole situation. In any case this is a crazy school love comedy adventure! An adventure of an upperclassman and her friend trying to be impregnated!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE043117.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
看来大家都在争夺主角星龙君的基因！！他们甚至还举办了一场比赛！然而，他们却对整个事件背后的可疑阴谋知之甚少。无论如何，这都是一场疯狂的校园爱情喜剧冒险！一名高年级学生和她的朋友试图怀孕的冒险！

[来自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE043117.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
